evidence_gaps: Temperature limits are provisional starting values from the team research brief; not tuned to local varieties.
Stage lengths are FAO-56 Table 11 general values, scaled to each season; FAO says they 'may vary substantially' by region and variety and local data should be preferred.
Drought, waterlogging and disease thresholds are not yet sourced.
No thresholds for the late season (maturity) yet.
stage_lengths_source: FAO-56 Table 11, 'Grains (small)', planted Oct/Nov, region 'Pakistan; Arid Reg.' (165 days). No wheat-specific Pakistan row exists. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm
